# E0233: a minor version's disjunction cannot be shown to cover its predecessor's

The checker shows a disjunction compatible by finding, for each alternative of
the predecessor, one alternative of the new schema that covers it. Alternatives
that cover it only together are not combined, so the checker cannot decide.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				n: int
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				n: >=0 | <0
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0233]: n in schema 0.1 is now >=0 | <0, no single alternative of which covers the prior alternative int; the checker does not combine alternatives
  --> lineage.cue:11:5
   |
11 |                 n: >=0 | <0
   |                 ^
   |
   = note: schema 0.1 is declared as a minor version of 0.0, so every instance of schema 0.0 must be an instance of it (compatibility rule unknown-disjunction)
   = help: change the schema so the checker can decide, or make this version 1.0
```
